findings.reason: package.json:21-29 "files" lists bin, range.bnf, classes, functions, internal, ranges and index.js but not preload.js, and there is no .npmignore. test/preload.js:2 requires '../preload.js' from the source tree, so the tests pass even though the packaged artifact never includes the file.
findings.claim: preload.js is missing from the package.json "files" allowlist, so it is not published and require('semver/preload') fails for installed consumers.
findings.evidence: The diff adds only preload.js at the repo root. package.json "files" is still ["bin", "range.bnf", "classes", "functions", "internal", "ranges", "index.js"] and has no "preload.js" entry. test/preload.js requires '../preload.js' from the source tree, so it never tests the packaged artifact.

findings.reason: The duplication is real, but test/preload.js:4 runs strictSame(preload, index), so any export added to index.js and not to preload.js fails the suite. The drift risk is already covered, and this is a style choice rather than a defect in this change.
findings.claim: preload.js repeats index.js's export list by hand and could drift from it.
findings.evidence: preload.js lists 43 `require(...)` entries that repeat the `lazyExport(...)` calls in index.js lines 23-64 one by one, instead of building the object from a shared list.
